fields.summary_ko.0: Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) is a mega-cap company with market capitalization exceeding $200 billion, with total revenue up 12.38% year-over-year and net income up 31.09% year-over-year.
fields.summary_ko.1: It operates three business segments: North America, International, and AWS, with EPS up 29.81% year-over-year.
